sentences.text:
Balaji vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. on 14 March,
2024
Author: Pankaj Bhatia

Bench: Pankaj Bhatia
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:22604
Court No. - 12
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 2908 of 2024
Applicant :- Balaji

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in Fir No.477 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc
and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Risiya, District Bahraich.

3.  It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that on the same allegations, the mother-in-law has been enlarged on bail by this Court vide order dated 12.03.2024 passed in Criminal Misc.
Application No.2760 of 2024.
The applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased.
Balaji vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Balaji vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that on the same allegations, the co-accused, mother in law has already been enlarged on bail and as such, the applicant, who is father-in-law, is entitled to be released on bail on the same reasoning as adopted in the order dated 12.03.2024.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Balaji be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 14.3.2024 akverma  Balaji vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
